zh.summary: 登录会自动打开浏览器，官方 0.2.1-alpha.3 内核可选，导出数据默认加密，换用较旧内核时给出提示。
highlights: 点击登录后会自动在默认浏览器里打开登录页，不用再手动复制链接，登录窗口也不会一直转圈等不到页面。
官方 0.2.1-alpha.3 内核通过验收，加入可选内核；可选内核仍保留最新的 RC。
导出数据时默认选“密码加密”。如果选普通文件并包含凭据，会明确提醒文件里的 API 凭据没有加密。
在更新页选择比当前更旧的内核时，会提示新内核创建的会话在旧内核里可能打不开，数据不会被删除。
upgradeNotes: 升级会保留设置、会话、插件和默认工作区。

en.summary: Sign-in opens your browser automatically, the official 0.2.1-alpha.3 engine is selectable, data export is encrypted by default, and choosing an older engine now shows a hint.
highlights: Signing in now opens the sign-in page in your default browser by itself, so you no longer copy a link by hand and the dialog no longer spins with nothing to continue.
The official 0.2.1-alpha.3 engine passed acceptance and joins the selectable engines; the newest release candidate stays in the list.
Export defaults to password encryption. Choosing a standard file that includes credentials clearly warns that the API credentials in it are not encrypted.
Choosing an engine older than the current one on the update page now warns that sessions created with a newer engine may not open in it; nothing is deleted.
upgradeNotes: Upgrading keeps settings, sessions, plugins, and the default workspace.
